confirmed: The named YZune/WakeUpSchedule repository is a non-fork 2018 project; its README explicitly says it only imports Suzhou University courses. Its pinned full tree has no THUParser.java, no schedule_parser/parser/THUParser.java path, and no LICENSE file; GitHub license metadata is null.

The THUParser.java path cited by Sleepy exists instead in lingion/wakeup-mod at pinned SHA 879f0d6781da19d1da9300d5eda6b0c2629b6a63. Its README identifies the tree as reverse-engineered WakeUp v6.1.06, not the 2018 YZune GitHub source. GitHub API marks this repository as non-fork, but its README documents derivative origin.

That decompiled THUParser has start/end arrays [0,1,3,6,8,10,12] and [0,2,5,7,9,11,14], gridColumns/gridData extraction, a 14-slot time table ending 21:45, C1 strHTML/strHTML1 handling, C2 blue_red_none branch, and explicit 全周/前八周/后八周/单周/双周 handling. These facts belong to the derivative APK source tree, not the named YZune repository.
contradictions: Sleepy docs attribute THUParser.java and Apache-2.0 licensing to YZune/WakeUpSchedule; the named repository lacks both. Its README limits course import to Suzhou University.
Sleepy attribution list records 3,500 stars for the named repository; current GitHub metadata reports 29.

The 14-slot WakeUp table in the inspected derivative source uses slot 10 17:05-17:50, slot 11 17:55-18:40, slot 12 19:20-20:05, slot 13 20:10-20:55, slot 14 21:00-21:45. Sleepy protocol-matrix lists different times for slots 10-14, ending 22:00, despite calling the source span 08:00-21:45.
The C1/C2/week claims are supported by the decompiled derivative source but are misattributed to YZune/WakeUpSchedule as an independent upstream repository.
